exposure: Children born via emergency cesarean delivery
cohort: 19,142 children from the Taiwan Birth Cohort Study (TBCS) database
finding: While initial analyses suggested an association between cesarean delivery and NDDs, this association was attenuated after adjusting for confounding factors, particularly gestational age at birth.
mod_finding: Emergency cesarean delivery was initially associated with higher odds of NDDs compared to vaginal delivery, but this association weakened after adjustments.
